name: ilGhera Contributo RAEE for WooCommerce
author: ilGhera

sections.description:
ilGhera Contributo RAEE for WooCommerce is the plugin that allows you to easily and automatically manage the RAEE eco-fee in your WooCommerce store, in compliance with Italian regulations (D.Lgs. 49/2014).

Main Features

  • RAEE Categories (R1-R5) – Full support for all RAEE categories
  • Preloaded Rates – Erion rates already configured and ready to use
  • Automatic Calculation – The eco-fee is automatically calculated in cart and checkout
  • Product Metabox – Dedicated tab in product settings to assign category and rate
  • Customizable Rates – Ability to override the rate for individual products
  • Bulk Actions – Quick assignment of RAEE category to multiple products
  • HPOS Compatible – Full support for WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage

Supported RAEE Categories

  • R1 – Cooling and climate (refrigerators, freezers, air conditioners)
  • R2 – Large appliances (washing machines, dishwashers, ovens)
  • R3 – TV and monitors (televisions, monitors, displays)
  • R4 – Small appliances and electronics (small appliances, PCs, phones)
  • R5 – Lighting sources (lamps, fluorescent tubes)

Documentation

Visit the complete documentation for detailed guides on using the plugin.

Support

For assistance, visit the support forum or contact us at ilghera.com.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New in the WordPress admin panel
  2. Search for “ilGhera Contributo RAEE for WooCommerce”
  3. Click Install Now and then Activate

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  3. Select the ZIP file and click Install Now
  4. Activate the plugin

Configuration

  1. Go to WooCommerce > Contributo RAEE
  2. Configure general settings
  3. Check the preloaded rates
  4. Assign RAEE categories to your products
sections.faq:
What is the RAEE eco-fee?

The RAEE eco-fee is a mandatory environmental contribution intended to finance the collection, treatment, and recycling of Waste Electrical and Electronic Equipment (WEEE). It is required by Italian regulations implementing European directives.

Do I need to show the eco-fee separately?

Yes, according to Italian regulations (D.Lgs. 49/2014), the RAEE eco-fee must be visible and separate from the product price at the time of purchase.

What is 1:1 takeback?

The 1:1 takeback is a consumer right provided by D.Lgs. 49/2014. When purchasing a new electrical appliance, the customer can request free pickup of the old equivalent appliance.

Are the rates already configured?

Yes, the plugin comes with preloaded Erion rates.

Can I set a different rate for a single product?

Yes, in the RAEE tab of the product settings you can enter a custom rate that will override the default category rate.

Is the plugin compatible with HPOS?

Yes, the plugin is fully compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).

Can I exclude a product from the eco-fee?

Yes, you can mark a product as “Exempt from eco-fee” in the product settings.
